Cross out the pairs of the same numbers (4-4, 2-2, 9-9) or those which add up to 10 (2-8, 3-7, etc). Two numbers can be removed by tapping on them one by one.
In the Numberzilla puzzle game, the pairs must be located side by side. You can cross out them vertically, horizontally, and also when one number stands on the last cell in the line and another stands on the first cell line below. There can also be empty cells between the 2 matching numbers.
The goal is to cross out all the numbers and empty the board.
When there are no more numbers to remove, press PLUS to ADD the numbers below.
